title: Patriots' Drake Maye received shoulder injections before Super Bowl loss to Seahawks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots' Drake Maye received shoulder injections before Super Bowl loss to Seahawks
sources.description: Maye completed 27 of 43 passes for 295 yards, two touchdowns, two interceptions and a fumble in the 29-13 Super Bowl loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
